reason: A local personal bookkeeping plugin for recording, querying, summarizing, budgeting, restoring, and exporting income and expense data.

summaries.zh: 一款将个人收支保存在本地并支持记账、查询、统计、预算、恢复和 CSV/HTML 导出的插件。
summaries.en: A local personal bookkeeping plugin for recording, querying, summarizing, budgeting, restoring, and exporting income and expense data as CSV or HTML.

capabilities: record and query local income and expense data
calculate monthly and annual summaries and budget status
write local JSON, CSV, and self-contained HTML files
